title: Balatro Basics 3: Building a Successful Endgame
description:
Balatro Basics Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdNGt-ihEAcEY9VVwmqT4V80xWG9ZWA14 
Balatro Everyday Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4PPUfrs8jI&list=PLdNGt-ihEAcHeBy6CpppXck5i6PmZ-cau

Made accessible for beginners but deep enough for more experienced players as well. In the third episode of the Balatro Basics series, we focus on the Endgame. What game pieces do we need to win, and how to do we get there? Always, how should we be spending our money?
